comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts a gripper stop; PR-54 seats an access panel and installs two retainer bars.
comparison.physical_skill: Concentric screw/nut countertorque differs from planar panel insertion and bar placement into rib slots.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires locked angular repeatability; PR-54 requires a flush panel and one or two correctly seated retainer bars.
comparison.reason: Both secure a component, but the panel task tests geometric seating rather than force-coupled adjustment locking.
